name: The Flooded Mine
description: An old iron mine that has partially filled with groundwater. The entrance is a vertical shaft disappearing into the dark, and the workings below it go down three levels.

discovery.message: You find a rusted pulley system and a vertical shaft hidden by mountain scrub.

requirements.description: The shaft is too deep to climb. You need a rope to descend.

mine-shaft-bottom.text: You descend into the cool, damp air. The bottom is flooded with knee-high water. Two tunnels lead away from the shaft.

choices.label: Pry open the iron grate in the lower shaft.
Follow the tunnel with the rusted rail tracks.
Wade into the deeper water in the side passage.
Follow the old adit into the workings.
Climb back up the shaft.

track-tunnel.text: The tracks lead to a collapsed chamber. A skeletal miner lies under some rubble, a pickaxe still in hand.

miner-loot.text: Among the rubble, you see a patch of loose, sandy soil that looks out of place.

choices.label: Use a Shovel to dig into the sandy soil.
Go back to the shaft bottom.

hidden-ore-stash.text: You dig up a small wooden crate containing high-grade iron ore and some old coins.

water-passage.text: The water reaches your chest. You see something glinting at the bottom.
water-passage.success_text: You dive down and retrieve a heavy iron key from the muck.
water-passage.failure_text: The water is too cold and you struggle to stay afloat, losing your breath.

water-struggle.text: You gasp for air as you pull yourself back to the dry tracks. (Gained 1 Fatigue)

key-find-success.text: You've found a Heavy Iron Key. It might open something elsewhere.

the-grate.text: You jam the crowbar into the rusted grate and heave. With a shriek of iron it gives. Below, a rickety kobold scaffold drops into the dark, and you can smell smoke and wet fur.

scaffolding.text: The scaffold is lashed together from mine timbers and rope. It sways when you look at it.
scaffolding.success_text: You climb down hand over hand, testing each rung, and drop the last few feet into a tunnel lit by kobold fires.
scaffolding.failure_text: A rung snaps and you fall the last ten feet.

scaffold-fall.text: You land hard in the mud at the top of the shaft.

warren-guards.text: Yapping alarm calls echo down the tunnel and three kobolds with spears and painted shields charge out of the smoke.

warren-hall.text: The tunnel opens into a cavern full of hide tents. Three more kobolds come for you, shrieking.

the-shaman.text: At the back of the cavern, a kobold with bones knotted in its crest raises a burning hand. Behind it, half-sunk in a glittering geode, is an axe.

the-geode.text: The axe is half-sunk in a geode the size of a cart wheel, the crystal grown right over the head. Strike it wrong and you will shatter both.
the-geode.success_text: You find the hairline seam where the crystal grew around the steel, and tap it. The geode splits clean down the middle.
the-geode.failure_text: You can't see where to strike. Better look again before you ruin it.

the-blade.text: The Ancestral Axe: rusted, pitted, and still beautiful, clan runes running the length of the haft.

cache-or-leave.text: Past the geode the old dwarven workings go on: a passage cut square and true, with clan marks over the arch.

choices.label: Follow the dwarven passage.
Climb back up to the shaft.

geode-cache.text: The passage ends in a round chamber walled with geodes, every one cut open and glittering. In the middle, an anvil of black stone, and a forge that lights itself as you walk in.

clan-ritual.text: You lay the axe on the anvil and speak the names of your ancestors, as many as you know, as steadily as you can.
clan-ritual.success_text: The forge roars white. When it fades, the rust is gone and the runes burn gold, then cool to bright steel. The axe is whole.
clan-ritual.failure_text: Your voice catches and the forge dims. Breathe. Begin again.

blade-restored.text: You lift the Axe of the Ancestors. It's lighter than it has any right to be, and it fits your hand as though it was made for it. In a way, it was.

geode-retry.text: The geode glitters at you, unhelpfully.

choices.label: Study it again.
Climb back up to the shaft.
Begin the names again.
Leave the cache for now.

requirements.description: You need a light to go into the workings.

adit-entry.failure_text: Past the shaft's grey daylight the adit is black as pitch. You'd need a lit torch or lantern, or eyes that see in the dark, to go on.
adit-entry.text: A level tunnel runs off into the hill, its props grey with age. The miners' tracks run along the floor under an inch of water.

adit-loose-rock.text: Halfway along, the roof sags between two cracked props.
adit-loose-rock.success_text: You spot the loose slab hanging over the tracks and edge past it.
adit-loose-rock.failure_text: A slab peels off the roof as you pass under it.

adit-rockfall.text: It catches you across the shoulders.

adit-rats.text: Your light sets a hundred eyes shining at the end of the adit, and the floor starts to move.

adit-face.text: The adit ends at the old miners' last face. The iron here is richer than anything at the surface, and they left plenty behind when the water came.

adit-junction.text: Beside the face an old ladder drops down a winze into the galleries below. Water drips from every rung.

choices.label: Climb down to the galleries.
Work the face again.
Go back to the shaft.

requirements.description: The ladder is rotten below the first rungs: you need a rope.

galleries-entry.failure_text: The ladder is rotten through below the first few rungs. You'd need a rope, and a light, to get down there.
galleries-entry.text: You tie off your rope and lower yourself into the galleries. Old workings open off in every direction, half full of black water.

galleries-air.text: The air down here is thick and stale. Your head starts to pound.
galleries-air.success_text: You slow your breathing and push on until the air clears a little.
galleries-air.failure_text: You have to stop, gasping, until the dizziness passes.

galleries-bad-air.text: The bad air leaves you drained.

galleries-flood.text: The way to the working face runs under water for a long stretch: a flooded gallery, roof and all.

choices.label: Drink a potion of water breathing and swim it.
Hold your breath and swim for it (Athletics).
Turn back.

galleries-potion.text: The potion tastes of brine. You breathe the black water like air and swim the gallery at your leisure.
galleries-potion.failure_text: You don't have a potion of water breathing.

galleries-swim.text: You fill your lungs and dive.
galleries-swim.success_text: You come up gasping on the far side.
galleries-swim.failure_text: Halfway along your lungs give out and you claw your way back the way you came.

galleries-half-drowned.text: You cough up black water on the near side.

galleries-spider.text: Webs choke the gallery past the water, and something big moves in them.

galleries-face.text: The working face is cut deep into dark rock. Iron runs through it, and here and there a blue-black seam of deepiron, too hard for a common pick.

galleries-junction.text: Past the face, a second winze drops into the Deeps: the mine's last level, where the water came in.

choices.label: Go down into the Deeps.
Work the face again.
Climb back up to the adit.

requirements.description: You need a rope to get down.

deeps-entry.failure_text: The winze drops straight down into nothing. You'd need a rope, and a light, to go down there.
deeps-entry.text: You lower yourself into the Deeps. The rock here is warm to the touch, and the walls glitter in your light.

deeps-gas.text: A faint rotten-egg smell hangs in the warm air.
deeps-gas.success_text: Firedamp. You shield your flame and hurry through before it can catch.
deeps-gas.failure_text: The gas finds your flame and the tunnel fills with fire.

deeps-gas-burn.text: You throw yourself flat, but the flare catches you.

deeps-grimlocks.text: Pale, eyeless things come loping out of the dark, sniffing the air.

deeps-face.text: The deepest face in the mine. Deepiron runs thick through the warm rock, and in places it's laced with something brighter: silver-white mithral, and the black, violet-sheened adamantine that only a deepiron pick will cut.

deeps-way-out.text: There's nowhere deeper to go. Water seeps in through every crack in the floor.

choices.label: Climb back up to the galleries.

mine-exit.text: You climb the shaft back up into the daylight.
